paragraphs.source_en: Kubojima Magobē galloped all the way and, the moment he reached the arquebus unit, shouted, “Magobē!”

units.source_en: Kubojima Magobē galloped all the way and, the moment he reached the arquebus unit, shouted, “Magobē!”
units.source_zh: 久保岛孙兵卫骑马一路飞奔，刚到火枪营，便大叫起来：“孙兵卫！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 久保岛孙兵卫骑马一路飞奔，刚到火枪营，便大叫起来：“孙兵卫！”

paragraphs.source_en: “What is it?”

units.source_en: “What is it?”
units.source_zh: “何事？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “何事？”

paragraphs.source_en: “We are to fire on Mount Matsuo. Take twenty arquebuses to Lord Fukushima at once.”

units.source_en: “We are to fire on Mount Matsuo.
units.source_zh: “要打松尾山。

units.source_en: Take twenty arquebuses to Lord Fukushima at once.”
units.source_zh: 快带二十支火枪到福岛大人处。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “要打松尾山。快带二十支火枪到福岛大人处。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Understood!”

units.source_en: “Understood!”
units.source_zh: “明白！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “明白！”

paragraphs.source_en: “It is desperately urgent!” With that, Kubojima Magobē again raced like a whirlwind toward Fukushima Masanori's position. The ability to rouse men's spirits with only a few words was the strength of Ieyasu's trusted retainers.

units.source_en: “It is desperately urgent!”
units.source_zh: “十万火急！”

units.source_en: With that, Kubojima Magobē again raced like a whirlwind toward Fukushima Masanori's position.
units.source_zh: 言毕，久保岛孙兵卫又如旋风般向福岛正则阵地驰去。

units.source_en: The ability to rouse men's spirits with only a few words was the strength of Ieyasu's trusted retainers.
units.source_zh: 寥寥数语便足以振奋士气，这即家康亲信的强势所在。

paragraphs.source_zh: “十万火急！”言毕，久保岛孙兵卫又如旋风般向福岛正则阵地驰去。寥寥数语便足以振奋士气，这即家康亲信的强势所在。

paragraphs.source_en: But once he reached Fukushima, matters were not so simple. He would have to meet Masanori and convey Ieyasu's order. All would be well if Masanori nodded his assent, but at a single wrong word he might very well turn hostile. Fukushima Masanori was so fiercely protective of his pride that he could be obstinate beyond reason.

units.source_en: But once he reached Fukushima, matters were not so simple.
units.source_zh: 但到了福岛处，事情就没那么简单了。

units.source_en: He would have to meet Masanori and convey Ieyasu's order. All would be well if Masanori nodded his assent, but at a single wrong word he might very well turn hostile.

ja.t: にうなずいてくれればよいが、ひと

units.source_zh: 拜见正则，传达家康命令，正则点头答应则罢，一旦言语不合，他便极有可能翻脸。

units.source_en: Fukushima Masanori was so fiercely protective of his pride that he could be obstinate beyond reason.
units.source_zh: 福岛正则极重面子，甚至到了冥顽不化的地步。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但到了福岛处，事情就没那么简单了。拜见正则，传达家康命令，正则点头答应则罢，一旦言语不合，他便极有可能翻脸。福岛正则极重面子，甚至到了冥顽不化的地步。

paragraphs.source_en: Yet Masanori was unexpectedly amenable that day. He readily agreed and loudly ordered, “Bring Hotta Kanzāemon here!”

units.source_en: Yet Masanori was unexpectedly amenable that day. He readily agreed and loudly ordered, “Bring Hotta Kanzāemon here!”
units.source_zh: 可今日的正则却令人意外，他竟痛痛快快应了下来，大声命令道：“把堀田勘左卫门叫来！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 可今日的正则却令人意外，他竟痛痛快快应了下来，大声命令道：“把堀田勘左卫门叫来！”

paragraphs.source_en: When Hotta Kanzāemon, commander of the arquebusiers, arrived, Fuse Magobē also appeared with his acrid-smelling guns.

units.source_en: When Hotta Kanzāemon, commander of the arquebusiers, arrived, Fuse Magobē also appeared with his acrid-smelling guns.
units.source_zh: 当火枪营头领堀田勘左卫门赶来时，布施孙兵卫也带着气味刺鼻的火枪赶来了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当火枪营头领堀田勘左卫门赶来时，布施孙兵卫也带着气味刺鼻的火枪赶来了。

paragraphs.source_en: “Aim at the main position on Mount Matsuo and fire! Hurry!”

units.source_en: “Aim at the main position on Mount Matsuo and fire!
units.source_zh: “瞄准松尾山的主阵，给我打！

units.source_en: Hurry!”
units.source_zh: 快去！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “瞄准松尾山的主阵，给我打！快去！”

paragraphs.source_en: At the time, arquebusiers wore lacquered armor made of several layers of cowhide, with an iron breastplate five sun square at the front, and broad-brimmed Western-style iron hats coated in black lacquer. They had little to fear from enemy bullets, swords, or spears.

units.source_en: At the time, arquebusiers wore lacquered armor made of several layers of cowhide, with an iron breastplate five sun square at the front, and broad-brimmed Western-style iron hats coated in black lacquer. They had little to fear from enemy bullets, swords, or spears.
units.source_zh: 此际，火枪手所穿铠甲由数层牛皮制成，涂漆，前有五寸见方铁护胸，头上也戴着涂满黑漆的西洋铁宽檐帽，完全不用担心会中敌人弹丸，也不必害怕大刀长枪。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此际，火枪手所穿铠甲由数层牛皮制成，涂漆，前有五寸见方铁护胸，头上也戴着涂满黑漆的西洋铁宽檐帽，完全不用担心会中敌人弹丸，也不必害怕大刀长枪。

paragraphs.source_en: The forty arquebusiers formed a single line and carefully took aim at the mountain.

units.source_en: The forty arquebusiers formed a single line and carefully took aim at the mountain.
units.source_zh: 四十人的火枪队一字排开，小心翼翼瞄准山上。

paragraphs.source_zh: 四十人的火枪队一字排开，小心翼翼瞄准山上。

paragraphs.source_en: “Fire ten at a time!” Fuse Magobē and Hotta Kanzāemon gave the order proudly.

units.source_en: “Fire ten at a time!”
units.source_zh: “每次十发，给我放！”

units.source_en: Fuse Magobē and Hotta Kanzāemon gave the order proudly.
units.source_zh: 布施孙兵卫和堀田勘左卫门傲然下令。

paragraphs.source_zh: “每次十发，给我放！”布施孙兵卫和堀田勘左卫门傲然下令。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, the gunfire ceased.

units.source_en: Before long, the gunfire ceased.
units.source_zh: 不久，枪声停止。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不久，枪声停止。

paragraphs.source_en: At headquarters, Ieyasu was still gnawing his nails in anger, silently reckoning the time. This was the turning point that would break the deadlock, an attack proclaiming Ieyasu's resolve.

units.source_en: At headquarters, Ieyasu was still gnawing his nails in anger, silently reckoning the time.
units.source_zh: 家康依然在大本营愤怒地啃着指甲，静静计算着时辰。

units.source_en: This was the turning point that would break the deadlock, an attack proclaiming Ieyasu's resolve.
units.source_zh: 这是打破均势的界点，亦是显示家康决心的攻击。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康依然在大本营愤怒地啃着指甲，静静计算着时辰。这是打破均势的界点，亦是显示家康决心的攻击。

paragraphs.source_en: At that moment, the blind Ōtani Yoshitsugu, seated in his palanquin, must have been tensely awaiting the course of events. Of course, those most shocked were the men on Mount Matsuo. At the sound of gunfire, Kobayakawa Hideaki sprang from his camp stool, unable even to speak. The depth of his panic was plain from the three messengers beside him, all glaring furiously at him.

units.source_en: At that moment, the blind Ōtani Yoshitsugu, seated in his palanquin, must have been tensely awaiting the course of events.
units.source_zh: 此时，两眼失明、正在轿中的大谷吉继，定正紧张地等待局势的变化。

units.source_en: Of course, those most shocked were the men on Mount Matsuo.
units.source_zh: 当然，最震惊的还是松尾山上众人。

units.source_en: At the sound of gunfire, Kobayakawa Hideaki sprang from his camp stool, unable even to speak.
units.source_zh: 听到枪声，小早川秀秋猛地从床几上跃起，连话都说不出来了。

units.source_en: The depth of his panic was plain from the three messengers beside him, all glaring furiously at him.
units.source_zh: 他究竟有多惊慌，看看身边三个对他怒目而视的使者就全知道了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，两眼失明、正在轿中的大谷吉继，定正紧张地等待局势的变化。当然，最震惊的还是松尾山上众人。听到枪声，小早川秀秋猛地从床几上跃起，连话都说不出来了。他究竟有多惊慌，看看身边三个对他怒目而视的使者就全知道了。

paragraphs.source_en: Ōto Rokuzaemon and Ōkubo Inosuke, sent by the Kuroda, did not laugh. Instead, they fanned the flames from the side: “Look—at last you have angered the Lord of the Interior.”

units.source_en: Ōto Rokuzaemon and Ōkubo Inosuke, sent by the Kuroda, did not laugh. Instead, they fanned the flames from the side: “Look—at last you have angered the Lord of the Interior.”

ja.t: らせてしまいましたぞ」

units.source_zh: 黑田氏派来的大音六左卫门和大久保猪之助却并未发笑，在旁煽风道：“瞧瞧，终于把内府惹怒了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 黑田氏派来的大音六左卫门和大久保猪之助却并未发笑，在旁煽风道：“瞧瞧，终于把内府惹怒了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Now that matters have come to this, my lord, what do you intend to do?” Hiraoka Yorikatsu asked in a trembling voice.

units.source_en: “Now that matters have come to this, my lord, what do you intend to do?”

ja.t: はいったいどうなさるおつもりですか」

units.source_zh: “事已至此，大人究竟是何打算？”

units.source_en: Hiraoka Yorikatsu asked in a trembling voice.
units.source_zh: 平冈赖胜颤声道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “事已至此，大人究竟是何打算？”平冈赖胜颤声道。

paragraphs.source_en: After pondering for a long while, Kobayakawa Hideaki finally stammered, “M-messengers... Send the messengers at once... Send them!”

units.source_en: After pondering for a long while, Kobayakawa Hideaki finally stammered, “M-messengers... Send the messengers at once... Send them!”

ja.t: はようやくどもりながら

units.source_zh: 沉吟良久，小早川秀秋终结结巴巴回道：“传……传令使，快派传令使……快派！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 沉吟良久，小早川秀秋终结结巴巴回道：“传……传令使，快派传令使……快派！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Have you resolved to fight alongside the Lord of the Interior?” Before Hiraoka Yorikatsu could answer, Okudaira Sadaharu spoke first. Faced with such sarcasm, Yorikatsu had no reply.

units.source_en: “Have you resolved to fight alongside the Lord of the Interior?”
units.source_zh: “大人决心和内府并肩作战了？”

units.source_en: Before Hiraoka Yorikatsu could answer, Okudaira Sadaharu spoke first.
units.source_zh: 不等平冈赖胜应答，奥平贞治抢先问道。

units.source_en: Faced with such sarcasm, Yorikatsu had no reply.
units.source_zh: 对于这样的讽刺，赖胜竟无言以对。

paragraphs.source_zh: “大人决心和内府并肩作战了？”不等平冈赖胜应答，奥平贞治抢先问道。对于这样的讽刺，赖胜竟无言以对。

paragraphs.source_en: The spectators on Mount Matsuo had no choice but to wade into the mire of battle.

units.source_en: The spectators on Mount Matsuo had no choice but to wade into the mire of battle.
units.source_zh: 松尾山上的观战者，不得不蹚进混战的泥潭。

paragraphs.source_zh: 松尾山上的观战者，不得不蹚进混战的泥潭。

paragraphs.source_en: Inaba Masanari hurried over, and he and Hiraoka Yorikatsu swiftly issued orders to the messengers: “Descend the mountain together and crush Ōtani's force in a single blow.”

units.source_en: Inaba Masanari hurried over, and he and Hiraoka Yorikatsu swiftly issued orders to the messengers: “Descend the mountain together and crush Ōtani's force in a single blow.”
units.source_zh: 稻叶正成匆匆赶来，与平冈赖胜二人麻利地向传令使们下达了命令：“一齐下山，一举击溃大谷部。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 稻叶正成匆匆赶来，与平冈赖胜二人麻利地向传令使们下达了命令：“一齐下山，一举击溃大谷部。”

paragraphs.source_en: Kobayakawa Hideaki stood rooted to the spot, his brow drenched in cold sweat, saying nothing. Did he regret having decided too late, or was he still bewildered about what lay ahead?

units.source_en: Kobayakawa Hideaki stood rooted to the spot, his brow drenched in cold sweat, saying nothing.
units.source_zh: 小早川秀秋站在当地，冷汗满额，一言不发。

units.source_en: Did he regret having decided too late, or was he still bewildered about what lay ahead?

ja.t: いていたのか、それともなお

units.source_zh: 他是在后悔自己决断迟了，还是依然对未来感到迷惘？

paragraphs.source_zh: 小早川秀秋站在当地，冷汗满额，一言不发。他是在后悔自己决断迟了，还是依然对未来感到迷惘？

paragraphs.source_en: Hideaki's vanguard commander, Matsuno Shuma, came running over with a bloodless face and said, “My lord, you have ordered us to attack Lord Ōtani. Is that truly your will? Where is the honor in this?”

units.source_en: Hideaki's vanguard commander, Matsuno Shuma, came running over with a bloodless face and said, “My lord, you have ordered us to attack Lord Ōtani. Is that truly your will?
units.source_zh: 秀秋先锋松野主马面无血色，赶奔过来，道：“大人，您下令说要我们向大谷大人发动进攻，这是大人的真心吗？

units.source_en: Where is the honor in this?”

ja.t: はいったいどこにあるのですか」

units.source_zh: 道义何在啊？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀秋先锋松野主马面无血色，赶奔过来，道：“大人，您下令说要我们向大谷大人发动进攻，这是大人的真心吗？道义何在啊？”

paragraphs.source_en: Had Matsuno Shuma not opposed him so openly, Kobayakawa Hideaki might have had nowhere to vent his pent-up resentment. Though he knew he must descend and join the battle, he could summon no fighting spirit, and this tormented him deeply. It was Matsuno's defiance that finally ignited his anger.

units.source_en: Had Matsuno Shuma not opposed him so openly, Kobayakawa Hideaki might have had nowhere to vent his pent-up resentment.
units.source_zh: 倘若松野主马不如此反对，小早川秀秋恐怕还无处发泄自己的愤懑。

units.source_en: Though he knew he must descend and join the battle, he could summon no fighting spirit, and this tormented him deeply.

ja.t: しなければならないと
かっていながら、どうしても
かず、そのことにひどく

units.source_zh: 尽管他知自己必须下山参战，却始终缺乏斗志，亦为此苦恼至极。

units.source_en: It was Matsuno's defiance that finally ignited his anger.
units.source_zh: 正是由于松野抗命，才点燃了他心头怒火。

paragraphs.source_zh: 倘若松野主马不如此反对，小早川秀秋恐怕还无处发泄自己的愤懑。尽管他知自己必须下山参战，却始终缺乏斗志，亦为此苦恼至极。正是由于松野抗命，才点燃了他心头怒火。

paragraphs.source_en: “Uhyōe, bind Shuma! He dares defy a military order.” After a brief pause, Hideaki raised his voice again.

units.source_en: “Uhyōe, bind Shuma! He dares defy a military order.”
units.source_zh: “右兵卫，把主马给我绑了，居然敢触犯军令。”

units.source_en: After a brief pause, Hideaki raised his voice again.
units.source_zh: 顿了片刻，秀秋又大声道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “右兵卫，把主马给我绑了，居然敢触犯军令。”顿了片刻，秀秋又大声道。

paragraphs.source_en: Murakami Uhyōe hurriedly led Matsuno Shuma away. If the dispute continued, Hideaki might very well draw his sword.

units.source_en: Murakami Uhyōe hurriedly led Matsuno Shuma away.
units.source_zh: 村上右兵卫忙把松野主马带了下去。

units.source_en: If the dispute continued, Hideaki might very well draw his sword.
units.source_zh: 再纠缠下去，秀秋极有可能拔刀。

paragraphs.source_zh: 村上右兵卫忙把松野主马带了下去。再纠缠下去，秀秋极有可能拔刀。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, the arquebusiers trained their guns on Ōtani's troops below and unleashed a fierce barrage. From Mount Matsuo rose a battle cry that astonished both armies...

units.source_en: Before long, the arquebusiers trained their guns on Ōtani's troops below and unleashed a fierce barrage.
units.source_zh: 未久，火枪营把枪口对准山下的大谷军，猛烈扫射。

units.source_en: From Mount Matsuo rose a battle cry that astonished both armies...
units.source_zh: 松尾山上响起令两军都惊愕不已的呐喊声……

paragraphs.source_zh: 未久，火枪营把枪口对准山下的大谷军，猛烈扫射。松尾山上响起令两军都惊愕不已的呐喊声……

paragraphs.source_en: Persuaded by Murakami Uhyōe, Matsuno Shuma returned to his own contingent and later quietly descended the mountain, but he did not fire upon Ōtani. Immediately after the battle, he withdrew to Kurodani in Kyoto and then, following the example of Kumagai Naozane, became a recluse. But his conduct had no effect whatsoever on the Battle of Sekigahara.

units.source_en: Persuaded by Murakami Uhyōe, Matsuno Shuma returned to his own contingent and later quietly descended the mountain, but he did not fire upon Ōtani.
units.source_zh: 松野主马在村上右兵卫的劝说下，回了自己阵营，后来悄然下了山，却未向大谷放枪。

units.source_en: Immediately after the battle, he withdrew to Kurodani in Kyoto and then, following the example of Kumagai Naozane, became a recluse.
units.source_zh: 战后，他立刻撤到京城的黑谷，然后学着熊谷直实隐居了。

units.source_en: But his conduct had no effect whatsoever on the Battle of Sekigahara.
units.source_zh: 但他的行为对关原合战无任何影响。

paragraphs.source_zh: 松野主马在村上右兵卫的劝说下，回了自己阵营，后来悄然下了山，却未向大谷放枪。战后，他立刻撤到京城的黑谷，然后学着熊谷直实隐居了。但他的行为对关原合战无任何影响。

paragraphs.source_en: Kobayakawa Hideaki possessed six hundred arquebuses, and unlike the other units of the Western Army, his men had not marched through the rain, so none of their ammunition had become wet.

units.source_en: Kobayakawa Hideaki possessed six hundred arquebuses, and unlike the other units of the Western Army, his men had not marched through the rain, so none of their ammunition had become wet.
units.source_zh: 小早川秀秋拥有六百支火枪，而且，与西军其他部队不一样，他未在雨中行军，弹药均未被雨淋湿。

paragraphs.source_zh: 小早川秀秋拥有六百支火枪，而且，与西军其他部队不一样，他未在雨中行军，弹药均未被雨淋湿。
